author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-02-12 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And you agree he is the Lord?
context_before: Do you agree that a man’s history is made up of all of the events he has experienced? And if Jesus Christ has experienced everything I have mentioned, do they not constitute his history?
context_after: Then I say: only when salvation history invades time, will man really know the meaning of life, in time!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Salvation History (1968-02-12).
